[[FC Nasaf|Nasaf]] were the defending champions, having won the [[2024 Uzbekistan Super League|2024]] campaign. ==Season events== The current season saw an expansion from 16 teams. At the end of the [[2024 Uzbekistan Super League|previous season]], [[Lokomotiv Tashkent|Lokomotiv]], [[Metallurg Bekabad|Metallurg]] and [[FC Olympic Tashkent|Olympic]] were relegated to the [[Uzbekistan Pro League]]. The newly-promoted teams from the [[2024 Uzbekistan Pro League]] were [[FK Mash'al Mubarek|Mash'al Mubarek]], [[FC Shurtan Guzar|Shurtan Guzar]], [[FC Kokand 1912|Kokand 1912]], [[FC Khorazm|Khorazm]] and [[FC Bukhara|Bukhara]].{{cite web |title=2023 season fixtures released: Uzbekistan Super League to start on 3 March |url=https://www.pfl.uz/ru/m/news/view/15090 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604103623/https://pfl.uz/ru/m/news/view/15090 |url-status=dead |archive-date=4 June 2024 |website=pfl.uz/ |publisher=Uzbekistan Professional Football League |access-date=28 February 2023 }} The draw for the 2025 Uzbekistan Super League was made on 1 February.[https://qalampir.uz/uz/news/uzbekiston-chempionati-yangi-mavsumiga-k-ur-a-tashlandi-113742 Oʻzbekiston chempionati yangi mavsumiga qur’a tashlandi] In March, [[Uzbekistan Professional Football League]] established a partnership with [[Macron (sportswear)|Macron]], bringing the number of league sponsors to six. The date of the 12th round of the Super League schedule has been changed due to the international matches of the Uzbekistan national team to be held from 2 to 10 June.[https://pfl.uz/news/ozbekiston-terma-jamoasi-tayyorgarligi-uchun-superliga-12-turi-sanalari-ozgaradi Oʻzbekiston chempionati yangi mavsumiga qur’a tashlandi] On 7 August, [[Bunyodkor Stadium]] hosted a concert by singer [[Jennifer Lopez]] titled "[[Up All Night: Live in 2025]]". In connection with this, the match between [[FC Bunyodkor|Bunyodkor]] and [[FC Shurtan|Shurtan]] in the 17th round was moved to [[JAR Stadium|Jar]] stadium. After the program, the stadium's grass was seriously damaged.[https://qalampir.uz/uz/news/jlo-shousi-kuchirilgan-futbol-uyini-zararlangan-stadion-kirim-chik-im-va-kutarilgan-rumol-mavzusi-122651 Jennifer ketdi, ortidan havoga uchgan millionlar va rasvosi chiqqan stadion qoldi] Given the 3-4 months it would take to restore the grass, the home matches of [[FC Bunyodkor|Bunyodkor]] were temporarily moved to [[JAR Stadium|Jar stadium]]. On 18 August, the newly built [[Olympic City Stadium]] was opened in Tashkent, and it was decided that FC Bunyodkor would play at this stadium until next season.[https://zamin.uz/uz/sport/163167-jennifer-lopes-konsertidan-keyin-bunyodkor-yashil-rangiga-qaytdi-foto.html Jennifer Lopes konsertidan keyin "Bunyodkor" yashil rangiga qaytdi (foto)] In the end-of-season play-offs, Kokand 1912, Bukhara, Khorezm and Mashal retained their places in the Super League.
